title: OpenAI halted Astra for a cyber threat only OpenAI has seen
description:
OpenAI suspended its unreleased Astra model after internal evaluations placed it at the highest tier on the company's own scale for dangerous cyber capabilities. The same faculty that could chain exploits against defended systems could also find and close those flaws before any attacker arrives, but that defensive capability stays locked inside one lab while the knowledge of what's buildable spreads outward. Independent researchers at Black Hat confirmed the asymmetry the same week: offensive AI is outpacing the defenses, and their warning carries weight precisely because it was built from direct observation with no stake in any single lab's grading.
